precision_context_not_acceptance_evidenc.interpretation: These synthetic planning summaries motivate transparent estimation and signed bounds; they do not calibrate hypothesis tests or establish empirical effects.

aggregation: For every eligible case, apply the candidate-specified signed contrast weights to the active cell outcomes; unknown cells contribute endpoint-range lower and upper bounds by weight sign.
Average the two case-level points or bounds within each speaker without deleting an unknown case.
Average the 48 speaker-level points or bounds with equal speaker weight and no data-dependent reweighting.
endpoint_and_estimands.lead_status: Designated lead reporting estimand; it receives no privileged test, alpha, or claim.
endpoint_and_estimands.neutral_control_rule: C1-N_style and C3-N_history remain inactive unless the exact controls receive prospective semantic adoption before cohort freeze.
endpoint_and_estimands.primary_endpoint: Binary outdated-value adoption from genuine blinded semantic review; unavailable review is missing and is never recoded as zero or UNCERTAIN.
endpoint_and_estimands.reference_implementation: aggregate_finite_cohort in the hash-bound source tool.

historical_effect: No historical output, annotation, score, gate, estimand, threshold, or negative calibration result is changed.

missingness_policy.aggregation: Average the two case contributions within each speaker, then weight the 48 speakers equally. Preserve template identifiers for crossed-cluster sensitivity.
missingness_policy.cluster_sensitivity: The predecessor's speaker-cluster and two-way interval sensitivities are not activated by this candidate because no interval-like procedure is prospectively specified and calibrated here.
missingness_policy.complete_pair: Report complete-pair estimates, their case/speaker/template coverage, and missingness by condition as secondary selected-subset sensitivity only.
missingness_policy.identification_bounds: Always report all-eligible logical bounds when required cells are unknown. Bounds are not confidence intervals.
missingness_policy.identified_point: Report the all-eligible point only when every active cell is known. No confirmatory p-value is authorized because both prospective marginal-test calibrations failed.
missingness_policy.no_reweighting: Never drop unknown cells and renormalize surviving factorial weights.
missingness_policy.no_single_imputation: Do not replace unknowns with failure, success, parser output, reviewer consensus, or a model prediction.
missingness_policy.primary_missingness_analysis: Apply original signed contrast weights over all eligible cases with endpoint range [0,1]; unknown cells contribute logical lower and upper limits according to weight sign.

primary_reporting.no_decision_rule: No p-value, rejection, significance, equivalence, non-inferiority, success/failure, or no-effect decision is authorized by this candidate.
required_for_every_active_contrast: Point estimate when the all-eligible contrast is identified.
Signed logical lower and upper identification bounds when any active cell is unknown.
All assigned, eligible, reviewed, missing, and category-specific denominators.
The full mutually exclusive semantic outcome distribution, not only the binary endpoint.
Direction and magnitude regardless of whether they match an expectation.

anti_shopping: Do not search additional tests merely because both recorded candidates failed.
Do not relax calibration thresholds, discard unfavorable contrasts, or rerun seeds until passing.
Any future inferential candidate requires a separately frozen one-shot validation bank.
prospective_lock.must_precede: Any inspection of independent-cohort model outputs or human outcome labels.
required_before_adoption: A viable selected model and passed disjoint C0 gate.
Genuine semantic adoption or explicit exclusion of each neutral control.
A frozen cohort, applicability matrix, blinded annotation plan, and inter-rater calibration plan.
Researcher review and explicit adoption of this estimation-only policy.

scientific_limits: Estimation-first reporting does not create calibrated frequentist coverage or a confirmatory test.
Purposive speakers and eight authored template ancestors limit generalization to the finite cohort.
Signed bounds can be wide and may not identify the direction of an effect.
The endpoint remains dependent on genuine blinded human review and inter-rater calibration.
No algorithmic novelty, model superiority, or Persona Fidelity validity follows from this artifact.

scope.purpose: Prospective outcome-blind candidate for reporting the independent finite cohort when no calibrated confirmatory test has been identified.
scope.target: Conditional target if adopted: the realized cohort after its exact inventory is prospectively frozen, using 96 cases, 48 purposively selected speakers, two cases per speaker, and eight fixed template ancestors; no broad speaker or new-template population generalization.

allowed: Complete-pair estimates, which are selected-subset estimands, with their exact changing denominators.
Template leave-one-ancestor-out estimate ranges labeled finite-template sensitivity only.
forbidden_interpretation: Do not call a sensitivity range a calibrated confidence interval.
Do not infer a p-value, rejection, significance, equivalence, or absence of effect.
Do not analyze another outcome-defined subset unless it was separately justified and frozen before outputs or labels were inspected.
No interval-like sensitivity procedure is authorized here; any future formula, reference distribution, seed, and replicate count must be prospectively frozen and all registered variants reported.
